peers.name: grilling
peers.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

peers.name: domain-modeling
peers.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or recording or editing an ADR.

peers.name: grill-me
peers.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

peers.name: improve-codebase-architecture
peers.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

en.tagline: Interview a plan or design, and record ADRs and a glossary
en.summary: grill-with-docs runs a strict question-and-answer session on a plan or design. While it asks questions, it writes ADRs and a glossary. It does this by calling two other skills, grilling and domain-modeling.
problem: A plan or design often has gaps that only show up when someone asks hard questions. The decisions made in that discussion are easy to lose, and the terms used for the domain can drift apart.
With this skill, the questioning and the written record happen in the same session. The ADRs and glossary are updated as the discussion goes.
fit: Reviewing a design before it is built
Pressure-testing a plan that has open decisions
Settling domain terms while a design is being discussed
unfit: Quick answers that do not need a written record
Work where you do not want ADRs or a glossary created
steps: You invoke the skill on a plan or design.
The skill calls the Skill tool with "grilling" to run the interview.
The skill calls the Skill tool with "domain-modeling" to work on the domain terms.
An ADR is written as each decision comes up.
The glossary is updated as terms are settled.

zh.tagline: 追问方案或设计，同步记录 ADR 与术语表
zh.summary: grill-with-docs 会对方案或设计进行严格的一问一答。在提问的同时，它会写出 ADR 和术语表。它通过调用另外两个技能完成这些工作，分别是 grilling 和 domain-modeling。
problem: 方案或设计中常有一些漏洞，只有被追问时才会暴露。讨论中做出的决定容易遗忘，领域内使用的术语也可能前后不一致。
使用这个技能后，追问和书面记录在同一次会话中完成。ADR 和术语表会随着讨论同步更新。
fit: 对仍有待定决策的方案进行压力测试
在讨论设计时明确领域术语
unfit: 只需要快速回答、不需要书面记录的问题
不希望生成 ADR 或术语表的工作
steps: 你对某个方案或设计调用这个技能。
技能通过 Skill 工具调用 "grilling"，开始追问。
技能通过 Skill 工具调用 "domain-modeling"，梳理领域术语。
每个决定确定后，写入一份 ADR。
术语确定后，更新术语表。
